payload.title: Abstract — The Double-Triangle Architecture
payload.summary: We introduce the **Double-Triangle Architecture** for human-AI
payload.body: abstract the double triangle architecture источник mhtml снимок вакансии anthropic кластерам claude корень репозитория раздел диалога paper the double triangle architecture for human collaboration abstract introduce the double triangle architecture for human collaboration distributed knowledge work the central thesis each human participant modern assisted workflows simultaneously occupies two roles conductor personal assistants lower triangle directed downward from human assistants and performer coordinated higher level meta agents upper triangle directed upward from human toward team level coordination these two triangles superimpose form six pointed star topology which argue the correct architectural primitive for the next generation managed knowledge work existing systems implement only one triangle personal assistants cursor copilot chatgpt operate the lower triangle only multi agent frameworks crewai metagpt autogen operate the upper triangle only and typically replace humans rather than augment them neither paradigm captures the full structure how humans will actually work alongside over the next decade present three contributions formal specification the double triangle architecture including three inter layer protocols and six architectural invariants reference implementation via nautilus portal protocol npp which provides the federated knowledge substrate required support the architecture deployment paths for four concrete domains humanities legal medical social project management open source development and generic knowledge work also present empirical evidence from month single person assisted deployment producing lines production code across adapters formal protocol specification rest api sdk docker containerization and passing tests suggesting that single person operations can achieve team level output when the double triangle substrate properly instantiated conclude with open questions governance consent economics and burnout dynamics and invite research collaboration these unsolved issues table contents why single triangle models are incomplete the double triangle architecture three inter layer protocols nautilus portal reference substrate pattern library bridge between triangles four deployment domains open questions call action
